blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَسَكِّنُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب في الامر بالتيسير...، رقم:٤٥٢٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Make matters easy, do not make them difficult; create a way of peace and happiness for people, do not cause aversion,” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَنْعَشُ لِسَانَهُ حَقّاً يُعْمَلُ بِهِ بَعْدَهُ إِلَّا أَجْرَي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرَهُ إِلَي يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ وَفَّاهُ اللهُ ثَوَابَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever speaks a word of truth with his tongue, and that word is acted upon (even) after him, Allah Ta'ala keeps giving him its reward until the Day of Final Judgement. Then, on the Day of Final Judgement, Allah Ta'ala gives him its reward in full,” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودِ نِ الْبَدْرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَي خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو جزء من الحديث)رواه ابو داؤد، باب في الدال علي الخير، رقم:٥١٢٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever guides to a good deed will receive a reward equal to that of the one who does that good deed,” Hazrat Abu Mas'ud Badri (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.
